items.title: Gold gains on softer dollar, but heads for weekly fall
items.summary: Spot gold rose 0.2% to $4,177.82 on Friday as the dollar softened, but was down 0.5% for the week. Hotter-than-expected September inflation and an 89% market-implied chance of a December Fed rate hike weighed on gold, which pays no yield.

items.title: DTaP 96% effective against pertussis in Alaska outbreak
items.summary: In a study of Alaska's 2024 whooping cough outbreak, children aged 6 months to 6 years who had the full 3-dose DTaP series were 96.2% protected, and partially vaccinated children 85.3%. The authors suggest falling vaccine coverage and waning immunity helped the outbreak spread.
